config:
indent-width = 46
line-length = 88
[format]
quote-style = 'double'
keep-quotes = true
line-ending = 'cr-lf'
document-start = 'preserve'
document-end = 'add'
prose-wrap = 'always'
brace-spacing = false
preview = true
comment-spacing = 52
comment-starting-space = 'preserve'
max-blank-lines = 238
sequence-style = 'block'
mapping-style = 'flow'
indent-sequences = false
dash-on-own-line = false
sequence-expand = 'never'
mapping-expand = 'auto'
property-order = 'anchor-first'
